# homarr_app (Resource)

Manages a Homarr app — a bookmark or shortcut to a service, which boards then reference from their app tiles.

This is the one Homarr entity with a complete REST lifecycle, so it round-trips cleanly: every attribute below is read back on refresh and drift is detected.

~> **Destroying an app reaches beyond the app.** Homarr unlinks every integration associated with it — the integration's app becomes none, and only the Homarr UI can link it again — and app tiles on boards that show the app stay in place with a reference to an app that no longer exists. The same happens when a change forces the app to be replaced. Deleting an app that is already gone succeeds, so destroying one removed outside Terraform is not an error.

**Permissions.** Creating an app needs the `app-create` permission, updating one `app-modify-all` and destroying one `app-full-all`; each includes the ones before it, and admins have all three. Refreshing and importing need none of them, because Homarr lets every signed-in user read every app. A key whose user can only create apps therefore fails on the first change or destroy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A fully specified app tile.
resource "homarr_app" "grafana" {
  name        = "Grafana"
  description = "Metrics and dashboards"
  icon_url    = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons@master/svg/grafana.svg"
  href        = "https://grafana.example.com"
  ping_url    = "https://grafana.example.com/api/health"
}

# Only name and icon_url are required.
resource "homarr_app" "docs" {
  name     = "Internal docs"
  icon_url = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons@master/svg/bookstack.svg"
  href     = "https://docs.example.com"
}

# Apps are frequently driven from a map so the whole catalogue lives in one place.
locals {
  services = {
    portainer = { url = "https://portainer.example.com", icon = "portainer" }
    checkmk   = { url = "https://checkmk.example.com", icon = "checkmk" }
  }
}

resource "homarr_app" "services" {
  for_each = local.services

  name     = each.key
  icon_url = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons@master/svg/${each.value.icon}.svg"
  href     = each.value.url
  ping_url = each.value.url
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `icon_url` (String) URL of the app's icon, with no leading or trailing whitespace. Homarr ships a large icon repository; values such as `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons@master/svg/grafana.svg` are typical.
- `name` (String) Display name of the app. Between 1 and 64 characters, with no leading or trailing whitespace, which Homarr would strip.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description shown in the Homarr UI. At most 512 characters, with no leading or trailing whitespace. Leave it out, or set it to `null`, for no description; `""` is rejected because Homarr stores it as `null`.
- `href` (String) URL or URI the app tile links to, with no leading or trailing whitespace. Homarr 1.74.0 and later reject only `javascript:` URIs, in any letter case, and accept everything else, including schemes written without `//` such as `mailto:`, and relative paths. Homarr 1.73.x additionally required an absolute `scheme://` URL. Leave it out, or set it to `null`, for a tile that links nowhere; `""` is rejected because Homarr stores it as `null`.
- `ping_url` (String) URL Homarr pings to show the app's online status. Must be an absolute `http://` or `https://` URL with a host — the scheme in lower case, as Homarr compares it case-sensitively — and no leading or trailing whitespace. Leave it out, or set it to `null`, to have Homarr ping `href` instead; `""` is rejected because Homarr stores it as `null`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Homarr-generated identifier of the app.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = homarr_app.grafana
  identity = {
    id = "k723ruvksaauzjvapxpmt9f6"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) Homarr-generated identifier of the app.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = homarr_app.grafana
  id = "k723ruvksaauzjvapxpmt9f6"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Apps are imported by their Homarr id, which you can find with the
# homarr_apps data source or in the app's URL in the Homarr UI.
terraform import homarr_app.grafana k723ruvksaauzjvapxpmt9f6
```
